[PREFERENCE] User is experiencing issues with their laptop's performance and is looking for optimization tips.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on installing an SSD and provided optimization tips for laptop performance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Optimization tips include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Update operating system and software.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Disable unnecessary startup programs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Close resource-intensive programs using Task Manager.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Uninstall unused software.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Update drivers using Device Manager.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Clean up disk space using Disk Cleanup tool.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Consider upgrading RAM.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Adjust power settings for performance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Check for malware with antivirus software.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Consider reinstalling the OS for a fresh start.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering upgrading their RAM.  
[PREFERENCE] User primarily uses their laptop for web development, note-taking, and watching videos.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended 16GB of RAM for the user's needs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided guidelines for RAM recommendations:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 8GB of RAM: Suitable for basic tasks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 16GB of RAM: Ideal for moderate users who multitask.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 32GB of RAM or more: Recommended for heavy users.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised checking laptop specifications for RAM compatibility.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned DDR4 as the current standard and DDR5 as emerging.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested checking RAM speed and timing, recommending 2400MHz or higher.
